name: クギリビト-The DiVider-
detailed_description:
《What is 'Kugiribito -The DiVider-'》

Kugiribito -The DiVider- is a first-person horror adventure game set in Japan during the 1980s.

Players must navigate through a mysterious village, hiding from dangers while searching for an escape.

By collecting various documents and clues, they will gradually uncover the terrifying truth hidden within the village.

《Story》

――198X

To escape the fatigue of work, the protagonist sets out on a weekend drive.

However, while driving along a mountain road, their car suddenly stops, leading them to a strange, secluded village.

As they look around, a memory resurfaces—an article about an unsolved case.

"The victims of the unsolved case all uttered the same words with their final breaths 'I met the Kugiribito...'"

"The scenery looks just like the one in that article."
